title: Validation of Point-of-care Thromboelastography (TEG 6s) in Pediatric Patients
official: Validation of Point-of-care Thromboelastography (TEG 6s) in Pediatric Patients
summary: The goal of this observational study is to learn about the performance of the TEG6s in normal pediatric patients. The main questions it aims to answer are: What are the normal TEG 6S lab results in normal pediatric patients and how do they compare to existing published reference ranges. Participants and their guardians will be asked to submit a small amount of blood at the beginning of an elective operation for analysis in the TEG 6s machine.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-Patients less than 18 years of age undergoing elective pediatric surgical care in the operating room at Riley Hospital for Children

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known disorder of coagulation pathway(s)
* Administration of medications that may alter the coagulation cascade
* Patients in foster care or wards of the court
